# WCAG 2.2 Site and PDF Scanner 5.0.1

Version 5.0.1 is the first packaged GitHub release of the evidence-first website and PDF accessibility scanner.

## Correctness fixes

- Retains charset-normalizer decoding results for UTF-16 and Windows-1252 HTML.
- Generates JSON reports on Python 3.10 when internal mappings use `defaultdict`.
- Executes the dynamic keyboard-navigation check after correcting its selector evaluation.
- Resolves relative local HTML files and directories before conversion to file URIs.
- Produces deterministic LF text reports on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
- Makes generated web-report findings keyboard-operable and improves report landmarks, filter names, live result counts, and expansion state.

## Distribution integrity

- Provides an exact standalone Python runtime, normalized pure-Python wheel, normalized source distribution, SPDX 2.3 dependency SBOM, SHA-256 checksums, and machine-readable release evidence.
- Canonicalizes generated package metadata and archive fields so supported Linux and Windows builds produce the same package bytes.
- Requires two independent builds to produce the same exact six files byte for byte.
- Attests all six release assets with GitHub build provenance.
- Creates only a draft GitHub release from a tag pointing to a verified protected-main commit. Publication remains a separate maintainer action.
- Does not publish to PyPI. Registry publication requires separate trusted-publisher setup and approval.

## Validation

- Core crawler, local-path, JSON, sample-report, packaging, release, and repository-policy regressions across Python 3.10, 3.12, and 3.14 on Linux.
- Python 3.12 platform checks on Windows and macOS.
- Real Playwright Chromium checks for keyboard navigation, report operation, and narrow-screen overflow.
- Offline embedded diagnostics and regenerated synthetic report fixtures.
- Ruff, Bandit, runtime and development dependency audits, CodeQL, Semgrep, Trivy, dependency review, and full-history Gitleaks.
- Isolated wheel, source-distribution, and pipx installation checks.

## Important boundaries

Automated findings are evidence, not proof of WCAG, Section 508, or PDF/UA conformance. Complete evaluation still requires manual review, assistive-technology testing, and judgment about the content and its purpose.

Scan only systems and documents you own or are authorized to test. Reports may contain page text, element markup, URLs, file paths, and screenshots, so protect them according to the sensitivity of the source content.

## Assets

- `WCAG-Site-PDF-Scanner-v5.0.1.py`: exact standalone runtime
- `wcag_site_pdf_scanner-5.0.1-py3-none-any.whl`: Python wheel
- `wcag_site_pdf_scanner-5.0.1.tar.gz`: normalized source distribution
- `WCAG-Site-PDF-Scanner-v5.0.1.spdx.json`: SPDX 2.3 dependency SBOM
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: SHA-256 digests for the runtime, packages, and SBOM
- `release-evidence.json`: source commit, artifact identities, dependencies, and archive membership

Verify all checksums and provenance before installation. Start with the included synthetic site and review the generated report before scanning an authorized live target.
